2609.24691.title: What Makes a Good Medical Image Tokenizer? Rethinking Reconstruction and Generation in Medical Image Tokenization
2609.24691.paper_summary: Latent diffusion models now dominate medical image generation, and every such pipeline rests on a \emph{tokenizer} that compresses images into the latent codes for image generation to operate on. Thereby, the tokenizer choice bounds every downstream task from reconstruction fidelity and generation quality to the representations available for downstream analysis. Yet, medical imaging pipelines routinely utilize tokenizers from natural imaging on the hypothesis that their behavior carries over. However, this is an assumption never tested in the medical imaging regime, where datasets are orders of magnitude smaller and images exhibit far lower inter-sample variance. We present a systematic evaluation of medical image tokenizers evaluating thirty configurations across ten model families on twelve datasets at three compression factors, spanning reconstruction, generation, latent geometry, downstream classification, and memorization. We find that (1) performance on image reconstruction and generation strongly correlate, unlike prior reports on natural images; (2) modern tokenizers use nearly all of their codebook entries, but still leave most of the latent space unused; (3) training-set memorization is mild and is further suppressed by stronger latent space compression; and (4) discrete quantization can largely preserve downstream classification, with lookup-free schemes being the main exception.
2609.24691.paper_summary_zh: 潛在擴散模型現在主導醫學影像生成，每個這樣的管道都依賴於一個 \emph{tokenizer}，該工具將影像壓縮為潛在代碼，以便進行影像生成。因此，tokenizer 的選擇限制了每個下游任務的重建保真度和生成質量，以及可用於下游分析的表示。然而，醫學影像管道通常使用來自自然影像的 tokenizers，假設它們的行為可以延續下去。然而，這是一個從未在醫學影像範疇中測試過的假設，因為該領域的數據集規模小得多，且影像之間的變異性遠低於樣本間變異性。我們對醫學影像 tokenizers 進行了系統評估，評估了三十種配置，涵蓋十個模型系列，在十二個數據集上進行了三種壓縮因子的測試，涉及重建、生成、潛在幾何、下游分類和記憶化。我們發現 (1) 影像重建和生成的性能強烈相關，這與之前對自然影像的報告不同；(2) 現代 tokenizers 幾乎使用了所有的代碼本條目，但仍然留下大部分潛在空間未使用；(3) 訓練集的記憶化程度較輕，並且在更強的潛在空間壓縮下進一步抑制；以及 (4) 離散量化在很大程度上可以保留下游分類，無查找的方案是主要例外。
